title: E1 Riverside Community Centre – Days, Times and Prices – Lesson Audio

scripts.label: Script A – Phone message (projector, together)
lines: Hello. This is Riverside Community Centre. We have a new yoga class. It is on Wednesday. It starts at seven o'clock. It costs three pounds. Thank you. Goodbye.
questions: Is the yoga class on Wednesday? (Yes, it is.)
What time does the yoga class start? (Seven o'clock)

scripts.label: Script B – Conversation (projector, together)
lines: Hello. Is there a music class?
Yes, there is. It's on Friday.
questions: Is the music class on Thursday? (No, it isn't. It's on Friday.)
How much is the music class? (Two pounds (£2))

scripts.label: Script C – Phone message (activity: 1 Listening)
lines: Hi Maria. It's Lina. The art class is on Monday. It starts at half past one. It costs one pound fifty. See you there. Bye.
questions: Is the art class on Monday? (Yes, it is.)
How much is the art class? (One pound fifty (£1.50))

scripts.label: Script D – Conversation (activity: 1 Listening)
lines: Excuse me. Is the library open on Sunday?
No, it isn't. It's open Monday to Saturday.
questions: Is the library open on Sunday? (No, it isn't.)
What time does the library close? (Six o'clock)

scripts.label: Script E – Phone message (activity: 1 Listening)
lines: Hello, Ali. This is Joe. The football match is on Saturday. It starts at two o'clock. Bring some water. See you!
questions: Is the football match on Sunday? (No, it isn't. It's on Saturday.)
What time does the match start? (Two o'clock)

scripts.label: Script F – Conversation (activity: 1 Listening)
lines: Hello. What day is the dance class?
questions: Is the dance class on Tuesday? (Yes, it is.)
How much is the dance class? (It's free)
